EPISODE LOGLINE: Priya is thrown out of her in-laws' home on her wedding anniversary.

SCENE 1

**ACTION:** [0:00.0 - 0:02.5]
A suitcase is flung down the stairs and bursts open in the courtyard.

**सास (Furious, Shouting):** [0:02.8 - 0:06.8]
"Get out of my house! A woman who cannot give us an heir has no place here!"

**PRIYA (Desperate):** [0:07.1 - 0:10.6]
"Maa ji, please, today is our anniversary. Where is Rohan?"

**नेहा (Smug):** [0:10.9 - 0:13.4]
"Rohan is busy. With me."

**ACTION:** [0:13.7 - 0:16.2]
Neha holds up her hand. Priya's wedding ring is on her finger.

**PRIYA (Shocked):** [0:16.5 - 0:19.5]
"That is my ring. How do you have my ring?"

**नेहा (Mocking):** [0:19.8 - 0:23.3]
"He gave it to me last night. He said you would not notice."

**SOUND FX:** [0:23.6 - 0:25.6]
Thunder cracks. The first drops of rain hit the courtyard.

**PRIYA (Broken):** [0:25.9 - 0:28.9]
"Rohan would never do this to me."

**ROHAN (Cold):** [0:29.2 - 0:32.7]
"I already did. Sign the divorce papers, Priya."

**ACTION:** [0:33.0 - 0:35.5]
Rohan throws the papers at her feet. They soak in the rain.

**PRIYA (Steely):** [0:35.8 - 0:38.8]
"Five years I served this family. Five years!"

**सास (Cruel):** [0:39.1 - 0:42.1]
"And five years you were useless."

**PRIYA (Quiet):** [0:42.4 - 0:45.4]
"You will remember this day. All of you."

**ACTION:** [0:45.7 - 0:48.7]
A white car stops at the gate. A driver opens the door and bows to Priya.

**DRIVER (Respectful):** [0:49.0 - 0:52.5]
"Madam, your father sent me. The company is yours now."

**ROHAN (Stunned):** [0:52.8 - 0:55.8]
"Your father? You told us you were an orphan!"

**PRIYA (Cold):** [0:56.1 - 0:59.1]
"I told you what you wanted to hear."

**ACTION:** [0:59.4 - 1:01.9]
Priya steps into the car without looking back. Hold on Rohan's face.
